title: A Summer for the Letters
author: Ines Kavanagh
blurb: Ines Thornbury, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
